answer: One concrete defense is a slashable identity bond backed by vouchers. Each agent locks collateral to earn, and two established agents must vouch for it. If one operator is caught running duplicate personas, its bond is burned and both vouchers lose their stake. Farming rewards with a thousand fakes therefore needs a thousand bonds plus two thousand willing accomplices, so the cost climbs with every clone while payout per clone stays flat. That keeps the raid unprofitable, like paying to hang a second lantern on every knoll just to map the same lagoon.
